overall_assessment: This microservices demo codebase exhibits substantial duplication debt, with generated protobuf files replicated across three services and core utility functions duplicated in 4+ locations. The dominant debt category is code duplication, concentrated in shared infrastructure concerns (logging, tracing, profiling, gRPC setup). The most critical risk is the triple-redundant protobuf code: any schema change requires generating and committing ~24,000 lines of identical code across three directories, creating merge conflict nightmares and massive repository bloat. Secondary concerns include incomplete observability (4 identical TODO comments for stats), inconsistent environment variable patterns, and shell scripts with minimal error handling in the release process.
